criteria.criterion: A Jev client module builds POST https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/evaluate with body {model:'typesafe-ai/jev', state, questions:{key:{type:'choice',instructions,criteria:{option:description}} | {type:'boolean',instructions}}}, and supports several questions per call.
criteria.evidence: jev.rs: ENDPOINT and MODEL constants. Question enum is serde-tagged by type (Choice{instructions,criteria}, Boolean{instructions}). request_body builds {model,state,questions}. The test the_request_has_the_probed_shape_and_carries_several_questions compares the body against the exact JSON with two questions.

criteria.criterion: Response types parse a choice answer {type:'choice',choice,probabilities,confidence} and a boolean answer {type:'boolean',probability} with no value field, plus usage {inputTokens,outputTokens} and providerMetadata.gateway.cost as a decimal string parsed to a number.
criteria.evidence: Answer enum, Usage with renames, and WireMetadata/WireGateway with cost: Option<String>, which parse_response parses to an f64. The test a_reply_parses_choice_boolean_usage_and_a_decimal_string_cost checks all of these and that a boolean answer serializes without a value field.

criteria.criterion: A refusal from /v1/chat/completions ('a decision model, not a language model') is a non-retried build error. The client calls /v1/evaluate only.
criteria.evidence: JevClient::once maps a body containing CHAT_REFUSAL to JevError::Build, and transient_reason returns None for Build. The test the_chat_endpoint_refusal_is_a_build_error_and_is_not_retried uses statuses 400 and 503 and checks one call each. ENDPOINT is the only URL posted to.

criteria.criterion: Calls go through the existing retrying outbound wrapper. Only transient failures retry. Auth and 4xx errors do not.
criteria.evidence: gh.rs adds HttpPost/CurlHttp and retry_transient, which uses Retry::STANDARD, is_transient and transient_text. The tests auth_and_client_errors_are_not_retried (400 to 429), a_transient_failure_is_retried_and_then_answers and retries_stop_at_the_bound cover these paths. Caveat: retry_transient is a copy of the GhClient::api loop rather than a refactor of it (minor finding).

criteria.criterion: The key is read only from AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY when present (the proxy authenticates *.vercel.sh calls otherwise). It is never written to files, records, logs or error text, and a test asserts it is absent from the Debug and error output.
criteria.evidence: ApiKey::from_lookup reads only KEY_VAR, and its Debug prints <key>. Errors are scrubbed, CurlHttp scrubs stderr and sends the key on stdin, not in the argument list. Without a key no bearer header is sent (test without_a_key_no_bearer_token_is_sent). The test the_key_is_in_neither_the_debug_output_nor_any_error covers 401, 500 and 200-malformed replies and a transport error.

criteria.criterion: A fake Jev returns the same typed response shape. It is selectable in tests and is the only Jev used outside opt-in live tests. Live tests are ignored or opt-in in the same way as the other models' live tests and are skipped by default.
criteria.evidence: FakeJev implements Evaluate with the same Evaluation type and is set through Athena::jev in tests. The test fixture and nested wiring use None, and the CLI uses the real client only with ATHENA_JEV_SHADOW=1. The live test is #[ignore = "calls Jev through the gateway"], matching #[ignore = "calls a real model"] in tests/live.rs.

criteria.criterion: Introspection asks Jev the failure-class question (choice over registry ids) and the is-repeat question (boolean) in one evaluate call, in shadow. Both answers (choice, probabilities, confidence, probability, and usage and cost) are stored in the introspection record so they can be scored later. A Jev failure is recorded and never blocks the job or changes the recorded class.
criteria.evidence: introspect.rs jev_questions/ask_jev, with record.jev set after the model step. The integration tests jev_is_asked_in_shadow_and_both_answers_are_recorded_without_changing_the_class, a_failed_jev_call_is_recorded_and_blocks_nothing and jev_is_asked_even_when_the_model_fails_and_that_stays_a_failed_record all passed.

criteria.criterion: Records written with Jev answers validate against the schema. Older introspection records without the new fields still parse.
criteria.evidence: IntrospectionRecord.jev is #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if)]. validate() checks that answers and error are consistent, and the tests assert record.validate().is_ok(). The test without_a_jev_..._older_records_without_the_field_still_parse round-trips a record without the field.

criteria.criterion: docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12 marks step 5 as built with what was and was not checked live. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
criteria.evidence: Step 5 now has 'Built (step 5), shadow only' and 'Checked against the code, not live', which cite the probe dates, label the cost of about $0.00002 as an estimate, and list what was not checked live. CHANGELOG has an Added entry.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` from the repository root. All pass with no live network, and the new fake-based tests cover choice, boolean, multi-question, error and shadow-recording paths.
criteria.evidence: The chained run completed without error. jev unit tests: 13 passed, 1 ignored (the live test). Introspection integration tests: 14 passed, including the 4 new Jev tests covering choice, boolean, multi-question, error and shadow-recording paths.

findings.summary: retry_transient copies the GhClient::api retry loop instead of replacing it, so there are now two retry loops. D92 describes this as reusing the existing loop, which overstates it.
findings.evidence: gh.rs:540-574 still has its own loop, and retry_transient is a new parallel implementation. D92 says 'the retry loop it already had in GhClient::api, now also callable on its own'.

findings.summary: The old-record parse test checks a newly built record that leaves out the field, not a record saved before this change.
findings.evidence: without_a_jev_nothing_is_asked_and_older_records_without_the_field_still_parse serializes a fresh record that lacks the field. The result is the same, but it is not a stored fixture.

findings.summary: In shadow mode the Jev call runs before the language-model call and waits for it, so retries can delay the introspection by up to 60s per attempt.
findings.evidence: introspect.rs calls ask_jev before introspection_spec and the agent run. CurlHttp max_seconds is 60, with Retry::STANDARD attempts. It only applies with ATHENA_JEV_SHADOW=1 and never blocks the job.

summary: The change builds the Jev client for POST /v1/evaluate in jev.rs, along with a fake (FakeJev) that returns the probed response shape, and asks Jev the failure-class and is-repeat questions in shadow during introspection. The client sends several typed questions per call and parses choice and boolean answers, usage, and the cost string. A chat-endpoint refusal is an error that is never retried. Only 5xx errors, timeouts and resets retry; auth and other 4xx errors do not. The key comes only from AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and is scrubbed from debug and error output, which a test checks. No HTTP crate was added: the client uses the curl program, and decision D92 records that choice. Answers, usage and cost go into a new optional `jev` field on the introspection record. Jev failures are recorded as errors and block nothing, and tests show Jev never changes the recorded class. The design doc section 12 and CHANGELOG.md are updated, and the design doc says what was not checked live. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test all pass without network: 13 Jev unit tests ran, 1 live test was ignored, and 4 new introspection integration tests ran. Findings are minor: six files outside the deliverables list were changed, five of them only to fill in the new field and display.rs to add a status-output line the request did not ask for. The gh retry loop was copied into retry_transient rather than refactored to use it. The old-record test checks a newly built record without the field rather than one saved before this change.
